_comment: H2 profile -> serving-params map. PROJECTED defaults encoding the 12-config hardware matrix (docs/superpowers/plans/2026-07-11-agent-capabilities-and-hardware-matrix.md). install.ps1 Step 6 reads the profile id + ram_tier emitted by detect.ps1 and renders the backend llama-swap template with these values. H3 (selftest.ps1) MEASURES on each real box and refines these numbers; nothing here is measured yet.

_fields.kv_type: q8_0|f16 -> --cache-type-k/--cache-type-v (kept symmetric; q8_0 V requires flash-attn on).
_fields.agent_ctx_tokens: value for the agent's -ctx-tokens (compaction budget); matches ctx_size.
_fields.resident_tier: the model that stays hot (gemma4-26b-a4b|offload-e4b|gemma4-e2b). SEEDS the agent planner seat: install seed derives config agent_model from it when it differs from the workhorse (internal/tierseed); override or blank via config_seed.agent_model.
_fields.include_26b: whether the 26B-A4B model appears in the rendered yaml + swap group at all.
_fields.include_qwen38: whether the Qwen3.8-27B coder/agent model renders into the serving yaml (entry + resident-set membership where the template is all-resident) and its GGUF+mmproj join the install download set. Mirrors the include_26b mechanism.
_fields.include_qwen35_4b: whether the Qwen3.5-4B AGENT seat renders into the serving yaml (entry + swappable-set membership) and its GGUF joins the install download set. Mirrors the include_qwen38 mechanism. This is the small-tier counterpart: a 3.5GB agent seat for tiers whose workhorse is too weak to plan well but which cannot afford a 27B.
_fields.moe_26b: gpu (-ngl 99, experts on GPU) | cpu_moe (--cpu-moe, experts in RAM) | drop (omit 26B). When cpu_moe, install.ps1 drops the 26B if ram_tier is low/min (no RAM path).
_fields.backend: the llama-swap.win-<backend> template this profile renders from (cuda|vulkan|cpu|dual-cuda).
_fields.dual_resident: dual-gpu only: render two models resident (no shared exclusive swap group).
_fields.gpu_env: env vars added to EVERY model in the rendered serving config, appended after whatever the template already declares. Was an `if ($profileId -match '^blackwell-')` branch inside install.ps1, so a Linux install of the same tier silently did not get it. CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES pins the device (hybrid-graphics can resolve the default to -1); CUDA_MODULE_LOADING=LAZY is llama.cpp #22696.
_fields.media_seats: ALIAS-backed media capabilities this tier serves, rendered into BOTH the llama-swap models map and the harness config binding that routes to them (internal/mediaseat). Each seat: kind (vision|stt), name (the llama-swap model id AND the binding value), aliases, model/mmproj/vad_model (relative to the models dir), bin + lib_dir for a seat that is not llama-server (may carry __OFFLOAD_HOME__/__EXE__), ctx_size (vision runs its own smaller window), residency (swappable|resident - a ROLE, since group names are per-template), ttl. A tier declaring NO seat leaves vision_model/stt_model empty and the route honestly defers. FILE-backed media (image/video/music) is NOT here - those are spawn-per-job subprocesses under the GPU lease, seeded via config_seed and derived by internal/mediacap.

blackwell-16.notes: Config #1 (5060 Ti 16GB, Blackwell sm_120). 26B resident full-GPU (-ngl 99). REQUIRES the Blackwell CUDA-12.8 sm_120 build (Task H4) - the pinned 12.4 asset lacks sm_120 and the 13.x asset segfaults the MMQ kernel into a ~5.6x-slower cuBLAS fallback. H3 may push ctx to 64K with q8. config_seed: quality-first media bindings PROVEN on this exact tier (bf16 O1 = 3.9min/2048 render via RAM offload; needs the model downloads + >=~48GB system RAM — see SETUP-AGENT). TIER DURABILITY (2026-08-14, operator rule): the pooled 2x16 tier moved its image seat to Krea 2 Turbo (24.5GB — physically does not fit one 16GB card); HiDream-O1 bf16 via RAM offload REMAINS this tier's measured, quality-first binding. A 32GB-tier seat change is never an argument to change a 16GB-tier seed; this tier evolves only on measurements taken at 16GB. PROJECTED. J-media 2026-07-28: media_seats are informed by a LIVE REFERENCE, not a runtime measurement. This tier IS the workstation, and its hand-built llama-swap serves the same qwen3-vl-8b (Q8_0 weights + FULL-PRECISION F16 mmproj, ctx 16384) plus whisper large-v3-turbo. The Q8 + F16-tower pairing is the 8->16GB unlock: Q4 is where small-screenshot-text fidelity died, and this one seat owns screenshots/GUI/document OCR, which is why no separate OCR model exists (hence the 'ocr' alias here and on the other tiers that inherit this seat). DELTAS FROM LIVE, deliberate and NOT measured: the seat inherits this tier's q8_0 KV while the live entry sets no cache-type at all and therefore runs F16; and it adds --image-max-tokens 2048 + --no-context-shift, neither of which live carries. Same weights and window, tighter KV, an explicit image bound. Swappable, so the ~10GB seat is the only heavy seat loaded. (The former qwen3-asr HQ STT tier was RETIRED 2026-08-14 — Seat Frontier Leg 2 consolidated STT to the whisper seat after a paired house A/B tied on quality; stt_model_hq stays empty, hq falls back to stt_model by design.) TIER-DOCTRINE PASS 2026-08-16: agent seat pointed at the VALIDATED thinking-on 26B agent entry (0/15->12/15 at D1 with reasoning on, 2026-08-10) instead of the derived reasoning-off cascade seat (measured 0% as agent). Same weights as the 26B — no new download. Capability parity with the twin-arch sibling(s) is field-identical by design; the arch split (sm86/sm120/sm70) is a BUILD concern only.

blackwell-32.notes: Config #13 (RTX 5090 32GB / RTX PRO 4500 32GB, Blackwell sm_120). ALL-RESIDENT: the whole roster (~21GB weights) stays hot with no swap group; 64K ctx q8_0 KV inside 32GB. config_seed applies only to a FRESH ~/.local-offload/config.json (install Step 8). Spec: docs/superpowers/specs/2026-07-16-blackwell-profile-tiers-design.md. PROJECTED - H3 measures the real ceiling. J-media 2026-07-28: seats are RESIDENT here (win-cuda-resident places only that role - nothing on this tier swaps), so VRAM is ADDITIVE with the roster. Arithmetic, stated so it can be checked: the ~21GB roster figure is THIS TIER'S OWN pre-existing note, not a new measurement; E4B+mmproj at ctx 4096 (~4.5GB) plus whisper (~1.6GB) is about +6GB, which spends roughly HALF of the ~11GB the original 32GB design left implicit for 64K q8_0 KV, leaving ~5GB for four co-resident models. The 8B (~10GB) does not fit at all, which is why 48/72 get it and this tier does not. Because nothing swaps on this template, an operator who finds KV tight must DROP a seat rather than expect the solver to recover. Also note this backend has no Linux template (cuda-resident is Windows-only). PROJECTED - verify the budget on real silicon before relying on it. TIER-DOCTRINE PASS 2026-08-16 (PROJECTED): vision seat was e4b-vision — WORSE than the 16GB tiers' 8B seat, pure drift — now qwen3-vl-8b. krea2 + ltx25(1280x704) seeded. agent_model stays derived (26b-a4b): the 27B cannot join the all-resident set beside the 26B in 32GB; the thinking-agent upgrade for this tier is an open bake-off item.

blackwell-2x16.notes: Config #16 (2x homogeneous Blackwell 16GB; the reference box IS the workstation: RTX 5070 Ti 16GB ~896 GB/s + RTX 5060 Ti 16GB ~448 GB/s x8-electrical, PCIe Gen3 X299, quad-channel DDR4-3400, 128GB, no iGPU so the UTILITY card pays the desktop/DWM ~0.5-1.5GB tax). Full design + arithmetic: Drive Local-Offload-Harness/2026-08-02-blackwell-2x16-tier-research.md. TOPOLOGY IS PIN-DON'T-SPLIT: every seat fits one card and is pinned whole (splitting a fits-on-one-card model costs 20-33% tg — sequential per-token pipeline, harmonic-mean arithmetic, verified); the fast card holds the latency primaries + vision, the utility card holds the memory-stack residents + STT + desktop. The STT seat is residency=resident ON PURPOSE: it lives on the OTHER card, so it may run concurrently with any fast-card model — that concurrency is the second card's payoff for this route. DEVICE IDENTITY: pins are PCI_BUS_ID indices matching the reference box (0=5060 Ti, 1=5070 Ti); verify with nvidia-smi after any slot change or BIOS reset (this board wipes settings on AC loss) and substitute GPU UUIDs if enumeration moved — a silent flip inverts every placement. MEASURED verdicts carried from the single-GPU era and still binding: self-built CUDA 12.8 sm_120 build mandatory; no spec-decode except where llama.cpp has the model's MTP graph (Qwen3.5/3.6 yes, DeepSeek-class measured dead here); mmap (never --no-mmap/--mlock) for 70GB+ models + a warm-up request + a wait-for-RAM guard; all-experts-CPU wins for V4-Flash-class MoE until an -ot A/B on THIS Gen3-x8 link proves otherwise; -b/-ub 2048, threads 18; q4_0 KV banned; vision mmproj F16 only. SEAT LIFECYCLE (house rule 2026-08-02): every seat here is the measured INCUMBENT; challengers enter ONLY via documented bake-off in Benchmarks and Optimizations/. SEAT VERDICTS LANDED (2026-08-12..14, tier-matrix catch-up): IMAGE incumbent is now Krea 2 Turbo bf16 (24.5GB, 8-step turbo recipe) — won the blinded 32GB bake-off 2-0-2 over Qwen-Image-2512 (editorial + text-rendering pairs; record in Benchmarks and Optimizations/2026-08-14-nightshift4-notes.md), bound via DisTorch2 ratio pooling (the imagegen_pool_* seed keys; --disable-dynamic-vram stays mandatory on both launch surfaces) in harness 0.59.0. HiDream-O1 leaves this tier's seat but REMAINS the proven binding for every single-16GB tier (24.5GB does not fit one card — do not propagate the krea2 seed downward). VIDEO seat BOUND 2026-08-14/15 (Seat Frontier Leg 3, executing the 2026-08-12 verdict; binding mode DECIDED BY OPERATOR 2026-08-15): videogen_family=ltx25 — LTX-2.5 22B distilled int8, two-pass latent-upscale joint-AV graph, POOLED per house doctrine AT REDUCED RESOLUTION (1280x704@24fps — the doctrine outranks the resolution). Measured constraint driving this: the int8 transformer UPCASTS TO BF16 AT COMPUTE = 39.11GB LOADED (DisTorch's own analysis), exceeding the 32GB physical pool — at 1920x1088 no virtual_vram_gb value fits weights AND full-res stage-2 activations (three renders OOM'd). At 1280x704 with videogen_pool_vvram_gb=30 the pooled render is behavior-proven: 5.04s + AAC joint audio in 189.8s, donor 11.8GiB + compute 10.5GiB live, zero OOM. Pooled serving still requires the --disable-dynamic-vram launch flag (MultiGPU #191). Full-res 1920x1088 remains reachable via the STREAMING alternative (pool keys unset, dynamic VRAM on — measured 210s and 1.65-2.3x faster for bf16 graphs) as a per-deployment choice; this tier seeds the doctrine-conformant pooled recipe. Wan 2.2 weights stay on disk as the --model wan fallback family. CODER+AGENT seats DECIDED 2026-08-14 (Seat Frontier Leg 1, measured): Qwen3.8-27B UD-Q4_K_XL (16.7GB pooled, thinking) WON both — coder vs Qwen3-Coder-30B (v3 decision set 14/16 vs 7/16; actioneval e2e 9/9 vs 7/9; loser's GGUF deleted per the disk rule) and agent vs the 31B-agent seat (custody paired D1 tie 15/15-15/15 at -39% output tokens / -31% wall; actioneval 9/9 vs 8/9; 31B-agent entry kept as rollback). Its vision competence is NOT seat-grade (visioncanary Arm A 3/10 under non-thinking budgets) — qwen3-vl-8b keeps the vision seat. Named challengers still awaiting bake-off: escalation Gemma-4-31B-QAT UD-Q4_K_XL (17.3GB, split) vs the 12b/26b rungs; reasoning Qwen3.6-27B Q6_K (22.5GB split, 64KB/token KV); agentic Qwen3.5-122B-A10B-MTP ~70GB; speed gpt-oss-120b MXFP4; vision Qwen3-VL-32B Q4 (19.8GB split); STT DECIDED 2026-08-14 (Leg 2): whisper-large-v3-turbo took the ONE stt seat — house A/B (EN+ES, short + 90-126s long, language-hinted, paired) was a quality tie on every clean slot, long-form chunking parity confirmed, and whisper is the capability superset (segments/SRT/VAD); Qwen3-ASR deleted, harness stt_model_hq cleared (hq falls back by design); a field-audio (noisy) round may re-open the accuracy tier; TTS Qwen3-TTS 1.7B (Spanish) + Higgs Audio v3; video-frontier Wan 2.7 + HunyuanVideo 1.5 (recorded as future challengers only — no re-contest unless the operator asks). RETIRED 2026-08-14 (operator-approved, ledger 0-usage): DeepSeek V4-Flash (capacity seat removed outright — the frontier-challenger slot is VACANT, not awaiting V4) and gpt-oss-20b. Media gen takes BOTH cards under the ADR 0018 machine-wide lease (operator rule: never fence media onto one card). Review 2026-08-02 corrections baked in: videogen_frames stays at the PROVEN 81 (121-frame clips are part of the Wan fp16 challenger bake-off, not a seed); resident_tier is the 26B like every 16GB-class sibling; and the classifier ENFORCES the 16GB band (a 2x 8GB or 2x 32GB Blackwell pair falls to dual-gpu - VRAM is the largest card's, so a mixed 16+8 pair is a known detection limit). This backend has no Linux template yet (same class as dual-cuda). PROJECTED as a tier; the reference box is live — promote values to measured as the bake-offs land. TIER-DOCTRINE PASS 2026-08-16: agent_model seeded explicitly to the measured Leg-1 winner (qwen3.8-27b) — a fresh install previously derived the deposed 26b-a4b.

IMAGE ONLY by decision 2026-07-23: no video/music seat on the 8GB node. Model downloads stay out-of-band like the >=16GB seeds. PROJECTED. TIER-DOCTRINE PASS 2026-08-16: parity with the twin-arch sibling verified field-identical; the split is build-arch only. Candidate for a single '8gb-cuda' tier id — rename deferred (installer classifier + installed.json compat migration). HYGIENE PASS 2026-08-19 (8GB re-eval, nightshift-9; full proposal in Benchmarks and Optimizations/2026-08-19-8gb-tier-reeval-proposal.md): (H1) serving params are UNMEASURED-ON-REFERENCE -- the ampere-8 reference box (Aorus RTX 3070) never ran the installer (ADR 0017 records it UNMEASURED on harness 0.22.22; its capability report shows tier UNKNOWN), so the class's one verified datum is the HiDream ~5.9 min/render; any redesign bake starts with a real install + selftest on the 3070. (H2) the vision seat carries NO ocr alias BY DESIGN pending ocrprobe measurement -- blackwell-16 records Q4 as the measured OCR-fidelity cliff, so the omission is a quality statement, not an oversight; routing uses vision_model, so nothing breaks either way. (H4) agent_profile=research seeded in config_seed (the measured 0-to-72 percent small-seat lever; ampere-6 parity) -- the exact profile value is a bake question, but shipping UNSEEDED is the configuration the house already measured as broken. Low-RAM sdcpp image seed (proposal H5) DEFERRED, not forgotten: config_seed_ram_mid_high MERGES OVER config_seed (tierseed.Resolve), so a base sdcpp block would leak engine keys into the verified HiDream arm unless ~10 counter-keys neutralize it -- that is schema work (a config_seed_ram_low arm), not hygiene. PARITY NOTE (2026-08-20): the twins are NO LONGER field-identical -- blackwell-8's image seat is operator-decided Z-Image + SDXL (sm_120 hardware grounds); ampere-8 KEEPS HiDream-O1, the tier's one verified measurement. (H3) gpu_env parity with blackwell-8 added -- the reference box is a hybrid-graphics laptop, the exact failure class _fields.gpu_env names; verify at install that the dGPU enumerates as CUDA device 0.

(H2) the vision seat carries NO ocr alias BY DESIGN pending ocrprobe measurement -- blackwell-16 records Q4 as the measured OCR-fidelity cliff, so the omission is a quality statement, not an oversight; routing uses vision_model, so nothing breaks either way. (H4) agent_profile=research seeded in config_seed (the measured 0-to-72 percent small-seat lever; ampere-6 parity) -- the exact profile value is a bake question, but shipping UNSEEDED is the configuration the house already measured as broken. Low-RAM sdcpp image seed (proposal H5) DEFERRED, not forgotten: config_seed_ram_mid_high MERGES OVER config_seed (tierseed.Resolve), so a base sdcpp block would leak engine keys into the verified HiDream arm unless ~10 counter-keys neutralize it -- that is schema work (a config_seed_ram_low arm), not hygiene. IMAGE SEAT DECISION (operator, 2026-08-20): blackwell-8 runs Z-IMAGE + SDXL for image gen -- Z-Image Turbo PRIMARY via the sdcpp engine (the amd-rdna3-proven binding verbatim: Q8_0 diffusion GGUF + zimage_ae VAE + Qwen3-4B text encoder, steps 8 / cfg 1; vae_mode TILING not cpu -- the seed lint measured cpu as a 7.8x CUDA trap (cpu is the AMD/UMA value); Apache-2.0; FP8-class model on sm_120 hardware), with SDXL PRE-STAGED on the ComfyUI route: imagegen_ckpt RealVisXL_V5.0_fp16 is seeded inert while imagegen_engine=sdcpp, and the comfy route's unknown-family fallthrough IS the SDXL builder with that exact ckpt as its default. THE FLIP TO SDXL IS THREE KEYS, not one -- set imagegen_engine to empty AND clear imagegen_steps/imagegen_cfg (8/1 is Z-Image's turbo recipe; on RealVis it renders mush; the SDXL builder's own defaults are 30/7). This DELIBERATELY BREAKS the ampere-8 field-parity claim on hardware grounds: ampere-8 keeps HiDream-O1, its one VERIFIED datum (5.9 min/render on the reference box). Reference box: OptiPlex 7060 (RTX 5060 8GB, Gen3 x4, rebuilt 2026-08-19); its LIVE config is owned by its own session -- this seed is the durable tier encoding for fresh installs. Weights out-of-band as with every seed. Low-RAM arm still seeds no image path (the config_seed_ram_low schema work).

ampere-6.notes: Configs #10/#11 (3050 6GB). **MEASURED 2026-07-26** on an RTX 3050 6GB + i9-9900 + 32GB DDR4-2667 (spec: docs/specs/2026-07-26-ampere-6-tier-design.md). (1) RESIDENT TIER E2B -> E4B: E4B at 16K/q8_0 occupies only 3100 MiB of 6144, so the stronger workhorse fits with room to spare - a pure GPU-side win. (2) CTX 16K -> 32K: the projected 'may downshift to 8K' worry was unfounded; E4B reaches 64K/f16 in 4046 MiB and E2B 64K/f16 in 2078 MiB. 32K is chosen to leave GPU headroom for whatever else shares the card. (3) 'q8_0 KV is MANDATORY' was FALSE: Gemma-4 E-series uses a 512-token sliding window with only periodic global layers, so KV barely grows - f16 at 16K costs just 130 MiB more than q8_0. q8_0 is kept as the conservative default; f16 is available if a deployment wants it. (4) **26B STAYS DROPPED - THIS IS AN ARCHITECTURAL DECISION, NOT A CAPACITY LIMIT. DO NOT 'FIX' IT.** The 26B-A4B was measured to RUN here (--n-cpu-moe 24 serves at 32K, 210 pp / 13.5 tg), so a future reader WILL be tempted to enable it. Don't: any MoE tier puts experts in CPU+RAM, and boxes in this class are SERVERS whose CPU and RAM are reserved for their services - inference is confined to the GPU. Enabling it also pushes VRAM to ~5.3GB of 6144, starving a desktop session sharing the card. If a genuinely dedicated inference box ever lands in this profile, give it its OWN profile id rather than flipping this one. Throughput: E2B 2631 pp / 90.9 tg; E4B 1529 pp / 48.1 tg. The 70W power cap (not raisable) is the real limiter - the card sustains ~1639 MHz of a 2100 MHz max at 58W mean. NOTE for ZFS hosts: ARC grew to 19.9GB of 31GB here and is NOT counted in MemAvailable, so cap zfs_arc_max to keep the memory picture honest for the services. TIER-DOCTRINE PASS 2026-08-16: reviewed; seats are the best that fit — no change. **AGENT SEAT BOUND 2026-08-17 (qwen3.5-4b-agent) — the first measured sub-27B agent-seat decision the house has ever had.** 15 candidates across families were served on the reference RTX 3050 and scored on TWO task shapes with FABRICATION as the disqualifying axis: shape B (read 3 docs -> structured extraction, 18-fact gold set) and shape C (5-file fixture with distractors -> search+select, cross-file arithmetic with a unit conversion, conditional reasoning, and a fabrication trap). Qwen3.5-4B is the ONLY candidate strong on BOTH - 67% extraction (vs the e4b incumbent's 50%) and 4/5 search+reason - at 3681 MiB with ctx 32768 q8_0, which fits beside the resident support tier. Every other candidate fails one of the tier's FOUR mapped failure modes: (1) loop and never answer (qwen3.5-2b wins extraction at 78% then scores 1/5 on shape C, deriving right answers in prose and looping until the budget dies), (2) answer from partial reads (qwen3-30b-a3b scores the highest extraction of anything tested at 83% and then 1/5 - valid JSON with confidently WRONG content, which is worse for a delegation lane than returning nothing), (3) refuse tools entirely (ling-mini-2.0), (4) never emit valid JSON (lfm2.5). ZERO fabrications from any model across ~40 runs and both shapes - these models omit rather than invent, which is the property the delegation design depends on. Qwen3.6-35B-A3B-MTP matched the winner on both shapes and is REJECTED ON THIS TIER'S ROLE BOUNDARY, not on quality: it needs RSS 21.7 GB on a box whose baseline available RAM is 24.3 GB and which runs 24/7 services - recorded as the ceiling this tier could reach if a node were ever repurposed as a dedicated inference box. **TWO CONFIGURATION FACTS THAT ARE LOAD-BEARING, BOTH MEASURED - DO NOT 'TIDY' THEM AWAY.** (a) The seat's llama-swap entry writes its flags EXPLICITLY instead of using the ${common} macro, because ${common} pins `--reasoning off` and this is a THINKING model: measured at the deployed ctx, with a FRESH server per run (n=3 per arm, zero spread) the same seat scores 67%/67%/67% under llama.cpp's default reasoning and collapses to 28%/28%/28% with `--reasoning off`, while the search+reason shape is 4/5 on both arms — so reasoning-off costs half the extraction recall and buys nothing. The cascade's reasoning-off invariant must never be extended to this entry. (b) The AGENT PROFILE is the single biggest lever on this tier - same model, same contract, `--profile general` (the DEFAULT, 11 tools) scores 0% with zero output bytes while `--profile research` scores 72%. The delegation lane already defaulted to `research`, and this tier now SEEDS `agent_profile: research` so the other agent front doors (the `agent_run` MCP tool and the `local-agent` CLI) inherit it instead of falling to bare `general` by omission — that open question is CLOSED, on the measurement above. An explicit per-call/`--profile` value still wins, and `--two-tier` is exempt because it sets its own architect/editor toolsets. Full evidence: Benchmarks and Optimizations/2026-08-17-ampere6-seat-bakeoff/ (the tier matrix records the seat DECISION; benchmark data lives in the benchmarks folder, not in the workbook).

amd-rdna3.notes: Config #7 (780M/gfx1103 iGPU + 64GB dual-channel DDR5, Vulkan UMA). SAFE FLOOR: f16 KV + 16K ctx + 26B cpu-moe (ram_tier mid/high; else dropped). Research 2026-07-23 (J1): the floor is deliberately BELOW what this hardware measures elsewhere - 26B-A4B Q4_K_M runs FULLY OFFLOADED (-ngl 99, weights in GTT/shared memory) at ~20-25 tok/s tg on a 780M with dual-channel DDR5 (two independent community measurements; the earlier 'cpu-moe = very slow' note was wrong for dual-channel boxes), and Vulkan FA + q8_0 KV is production-supported since the Feb-Mar 2026 AMD tuning PRs. selftest.ps1's H3 canaries (fa_q8kv / moe_full_offload / ctx_sweep) MEASURE all three promotions on the real box; the agent applies them canary-gated per SETUP-AGENT.md (amd-rdna3 chapter). REQUIRES a llama.cpp win-vulkan build >= Mar-2026 (the pinned tag satisfies this - it is the frontier snapshot, never downgrade below the floor) and flash-attn EXPLICITLY 'on' (never auto: a silent FA-off then fails quantized-V loads on Gemma). Single-channel RAM is a clean ~2x tg loss - confirm dual-channel at install. PROJECTED until receipts return. J-media 2026-07-28 (Juan's tier - the D9 audit gap): STT via the whisper.cpp Vulkan build. Vision reuses this tier's resident E4B + mmproj, so no extra multi-GB download on a UMA box. Vision keeps the CLIP encoder on CPU (--no-mmproj-offload). The REASON, stated accurately: llama.cpp #20081 reports mmproj quality degradation on Vulkan, but the maintainer could not reproduce it across several devices and the reporter closed it inconclusively - so quality alone is weak evidence. The load-bearing fact is in the same thread: running model + mmproj both on the Vulkan backend of a Radeon 780M iGPU gives a hard vk::DeviceLostError immediately after 'decoding image batch 1/8', reproducibly, on the exact silicon this tier targets. Keeping the encoder on CPU avoids that crash path and costs only encoder throughput; the LLM still decodes on the GPU. Both seats pin GGML_VK_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0 (multi-ICD boxes). REQUIRES a whisper.cpp Vulkan build + the whisper weights, which install.ps1's amd-* asset table does NOT fetch - `install render` warns by exact path. PROJECTED.
